Hi guys, this is mostly for people who write or install add-ons for the Proxmox VE web UI.

Proxmox VE has no plug-in API for its web page. An add-on that wants a button, a menu entry or a panel row has to get its script into /usr/share/pve-manager/index.html.tpl, and the clean way to change a file of another package is dpkg-divert. Code: 
devices {

     global_filter=["r|/dev/zd.*|","r|/dev/rbd.*|"]
}
